Real Daren-1997-Canopy data for tests/test_table_grid_checks.py.

- `Daren-1997-Canopy/provenance.json`: the raw TableCell entries (row/col index, cell text) of Tables 2 (b:0119,
  b:0178), 6 (b:0607, b:0656) and 7 (b:0761), copied unmodified from src/paper/Daren-1997-Canopy/provenance.json.
- `daren_step_b_answers.json`: Step B classifications of those tables as a model returned them, checked by hand
  against the paper: Table 2 has 7 values under the wrong column and one row whose population label the rendering
  lost; Table 6 has two such rows; Table 7's rows are Location x Maturity and Population means.
